name: @educateos/home-learning
description: EducateOS home learning (ADR-0016): parent-managed K-2 practice in a community installation. Families, their children's learner profiles and practice queues, reviewed reading and number-sense content packs with deterministic items, child sessions an adult starts and ends with a PIN, idempotent practice responses, and progress derived from that evidence. A library, not a deployable Worker.
